title: Stoker plugin project
description: `stoker-plugin.yaml` at the root of a plugin's repository: which plugin it builds, for which targets, against which release of the Stoker plugin SDK (StokerHQ/plugin-sdk). The SDK is pinned by version and by the SHA-256 of its release zip, which a build fetches and checks (`stoker-registry sdk`); nothing of the SDK is copied into the repository. A repository of several plugins has one file per plugin folder.

key.description: The plugin's key, as its manifest and the registry name it.

sdk.description: The SDK release the plugin builds against: `stoker-plugin-sdk-<version>.zip` from the SDK's GitHub release `v<version>`, checked by `sha256` — which the release publishes beside the zip.

targets.description: One file per operating system and architecture, each built from `source` (and `resources`, a Windows .rc, when given) into `<name>-<os>-<architecture>.<dll|so>` — the asset names a release attaches them under. Every target of a version builds from the same source, so every file carries the same manifest.

source.description: The plugin's source file, from the repository root.

resources.description: A Windows resource script compiled in (files the plugin carries).
